description:
Local OpenAI-compatible router that aggregates free LLM providers.

FreeLLMAPI aggregates the free tiers of dozens of LLM providers, plus custom OpenAI-compatible chat, embedding, image, and audio endpoints, behind a single /v1 API.

A router picks the best available model for each request, falls over to the next provider when one is rate-limited, and tracks per-key usage so you stay under every free-tier cap. Provider keys are stored encrypted, and the router refreshes its model catalog from a signed feed. Built for personal use only; each provider's terms of service apply.
Native routing for the November 15 renewable-free catalog additions:
- SilvR AI: three embedding models, Whisper Large V3 Turbo transcription, and Gemini Decision 1 predicate questions.
- Cartesia Ink 2 transcription: PCM16 WAV upload over the native, proxy-aware WebSocket with finalization checks and no ffmpeg dependency.
- ElectronHub images: Qwen Image 2512 plus dispatch for the two existing catalog image routes; bounded image decoding and safe timeout/error handling.
Also includes the current main-branch fixes for Windows bootstrap root resolution, explicit non-streaming chat requests, key health evidence, the Codex model catalog endpoint, and advertising the router's effective context window in model listings. Concurrently merged README contributor credits are preserved.
Provider free allowances remain shared, renewable and subject to availability. No new app quotas, paid fallback, Mistral catalog changes or premium/Free release-timing changes. Catalog publication is separate: seven additions and one retired Kenari route disabled, with premium access immediately and Free eligibility after the existing 30-day window.
